title: Bridge-cancellation form of transported adjunct normalization
statement: For fixed Operations, Compositors, OpenComparisons, and CanonicalBridge, the adjunct of the explicitly bridge-transported intrinsic gamma agrees with the prescribed properOpenLambda inverse after postcomposition with the canonical pullback bridge isomorphism.

source.place: Core gamma, adjunct, and canonical transport package

proof.text: Use the forward properOpenLambda bridge equation, proved by pasting the cartesian, restriction, clopen and compositor squares.

Multiply the lambda bridge equation by its two inverses to obtain the inverse equation. Move the source direct bridge across the open bridge by naturality. Apply left-adjoint uniqueness to transport the adjunct, then naturality in its source and target. Substitute the intrinsic gamma_adjunct equation. The inverse lambda bridge equation replaces its middle composite; naturality of the pull bridge and cancellation of the target bridge and its inverse give the claimed equation.

proof_origin.place: Four factor squares pasted in Lean, followed by intrinsic gamma_adjunct and bridge cancellation

from.place: Core gamma, adjunct, and canonical transport package

lean.statement:
theorem transportedGamma_adjunct_bridge (o : Operations l E) (c : Compositors l E o)
    (a : OpenComparisons l E o c) (b : CanonicalBridge l E o)
    {U V W Z : Scheme.{u}} (k : U ⟶ V) (r : U ⟶ W)
    (p : V ⟶ Z) (i : W ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion k] [IsOpenImmersion i]
    [QuasiCompact k] [QuasiCompact i] [IsProper r] [IsProper p]
    (h : k ≫ p = r ≫ i) (M : System l E U) :
    (o.extension i).adj.homEquiv _ _
        (((Operations.shriek l E o i).map ((b.push l E r).hom.app M) ≫
          (b.shriek l E i).hom.app
            ((ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.R (scalarRings l E)
              (scalarTransitions l E) r).obj M) ≫
          (ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.gamma (scalarRings l E)
            (scalarTransitions l E) k r p i h).app M ≫
          (b.push l E p).inv.app
            ((ProEtale.SemilinearProperOpen.J (scalarRings l E)
              (scalarTransitions l E) k).obj M) ≫
          (Operations.push l E o p).map
            ((b.shriek l E k).inv.app M))) ≫
      (b.pull l E i).hom.app
        ((Operations.shriek l E o k ⋙ Operations.push l E o p).obj M) =
      (properOpenLambda l E o c a k r p i h).inv.app M ≫
        (b.pull l E i).hom.app
          ((Operations.shriek l E o k ⋙ Operations.push l E o p).obj M)
